sk:storm_whirl: Hold to spin inside a crackling vortex, moving toward the cursor; lightning lashes everything around you and strikes one enemy every turn.
sk:flame_dash: Teleport a short distance toward the cursor in a burst of flame, leaving a burning path that sears enemies standing in it. Every half second the path deals half the damage shown, for 3 seconds.
sk:winter_orb: Conjure every orb of ice you can hold (one to start, more from passives and gear) by your shoulder for 6 seconds. They hurl icicles at nearby enemies (faster with cast speed and Winter Orb fire rate), then shatter in a frost explosion that chills everything around it. At your orb limit, casting again shatters the oldest orb at once.
sk:storm_brand: Throw a crackling spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.5 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with lightning that leaps to {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies), a tenth less on each jump. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 bodies that land apart (3 from gem level 20); a recast adds more until all your Sparks are up (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replaces the oldest. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.
sk:ember_spark: Throw a smouldering spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.8 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with a heavy blow of fire that sets it burning. It never chains to other enemies: it is the spark for the one enemy that will not die. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 bodies that land apart (3 from gem level 20); a recast adds more until all your Sparks are up (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replaces the oldest. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.
sk:rime_spark: Throw a freezing spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.7 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with frost that leaps to {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies), a tenth less on each jump, chilling the whole pack. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 bodies that land apart (3 from gem level 20); a recast adds more until all your Sparks are up (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replaces the oldest. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.
sk:venom_spark: Throw a festering spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.4 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host and {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies) with venom, a tenth less on each jump, and every strike adds a poison: the longer it crawls, the deeper they rot. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 bodies that land apart (3 from gem level 20); a recast adds more until all your Sparks are up (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replaces the oldest. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.
sk:thunderfall: Strike three times with your weapon (any weapon but a bow; a staff or wand suits it). The third blow calls lightning down on every enemy in front of you. Its damage is lightning. Spell damage modifiers also apply to it.
sk:glacial_shards: Flick {Projectiles} shards of ice from your weapon (any weapon but a bow; a wand or staff suits it). Each bursts into frost on the first enemy it strikes, chilling everything nearby. Its damage is cold. Spell damage modifiers also apply to it.
sk:reap: Your scythe's basic attack, no mana cost. A wide, hungry sweep that cuts everything in front of you.
sk:death_coil: Your scythe's mana skill. Hurl a coil of grave-magic that seeks the nearest foe ahead and bursts on it, rotting everything nearby.
sk:summon_skeletons: Raise skeleton warriors from the ground: two, and one more at gem levels 6, 11 and 16 (every 5 gem levels). While you are below level 10 it raises 2 more and costs half the mana, a starter's help that ends at level 10. They follow you and fight until they fall.
sk:summon_skeletal_mage: Raise skeletal mages that keep their distance and hurl bolts of dark magic at your foes: one, two from gem level 9, three from gem level 17. They stay until they fall.
sk:drain_life: Hold to tether the enemy under the cursor with a beam of grave-hunger: it rots while you drink, and the beam forks on to 3 more enemies nearby, each link a tenth weaker. A fifth of the damage comes back to you as life, and your minions drink with you.
sk:vampire_dash: Come apart into mist and bats and gather again a short way toward the cursor. The mist lingers on your path and rots whatever stands in it.
sk:summon_bone_golem: Tear a golem of grave-fire out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it; it burns in the colour of its supports' element. Only one answers at a time. Each golem blesses those near it: the grave golem heals you 1% of your life a second, the flame golem gives your minions 12.5% more damage, the ice golem gives you 31% more armour, the storm golem makes your minions 15% faster, and the venom golem makes enemies take 7.5% more damage. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.
sk:summon_zombie: Drag a zombie up out of the ground: two stand at once, three from gem level 16, four from gem level 24. Zombies stay until they fall, grow with the gem, hit hard and every fourth blow slams the ground round their foe. Supports such as Brutality or Flame make them brutal or burning.
sk:grave_call: Call every minion you have to your side. They come running (those far away step out of the ground beside you) and close in round you, then fight on with 30% more damage, moving and attacking 20% faster, for 4 seconds.
sk:unholy_void: Open a void of unholy energy around you: enemies inside take poison damage twice a second, 70% of the damage shown each time. The void gnaws at you too: 0.9% of your life per second, less with poison resistance, never the last tenth of your life. Press again to close it.
sk:grave_reap: Sweep your weapon in a wide arc. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Thralls that fight for you until they fall: up to 3, and one more at gem levels 7, 13 and 19; a new one replaces the oldest. 40% of its damage is poison. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, where nothing dies, every 4% of its life your hits take raises one too.
sk:soul_rend: Two heavy chops tear at the soul. Enemies hit are Rent for 4 seconds: your minions deal 10% more damage to them. 30% of its damage is poison.
sk:marrow_lance: Hurl a lance of bone that pierces through the line. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Casters that fight for you until they fall: up to 3, and one more at gem levels 7, 13 and 19; a new one replaces the oldest. 40% of its damage is poison. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, where nothing dies, every 4% of its life your hits take raises one too.
sk:pyre_burst: Set a fresh corpse near your aim ablaze. It bursts in fire, hitting every enemy around it, and deals 10% of the slain's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as extra fire (20% at gem level 20). Your own fallen minions count as corpses. With no corpse there, your nearest minion is sacrificed instead.
sk:hammer_blow: Your mace's basic attack, no mana cost. A heavy blow at the enemy in front of you.
sk:holy_slash: A wide sweep that leaves a crescent of holy light, striking every enemy in front of you. Your mace's mana skill; Hammer Blow is its free attack.
sk:judgement: Raise your weapon to the sky: a moment later bolts of holy light crash down on the target and the enemies nearest it, one after another, each exploding on impact. {Projectiles} {Projectiles}|plural(one=bolt,other=bolts); one more at gem levels 10 and 20. The bolts are not projectiles: Projectile skill bonuses do not change them. Judgement is a Skyfall skill: every Skyfall line reaches it, and second fall lines (Twice Judged, Twice-Fallen Sky) drop the sky again where each bolt lands (each enemy takes one second fall per cast).
sk:orbiting_hammers: Turn on a ring of {OrbitCount} spectral hammers that sweeps out through the enemies around you and back again, smashing everything it passes. It drains 6 mana a second while it spins (more with supports); press again to turn it off, and it stops when your mana runs out. One more hammer at gem levels 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20; from five hammers a second, outer ring turns the other way and pulses out as the inner one comes in. Hammerstorm empowers it.
sk:hammerstorm: Swear the hammers to the storm: for 6 seconds your spinning hammers turn half again as fast, reach 35% farther, hit 40% harder and three more hammers join them in a second ring. If no hammers are spinning, it calls them.
sk:consecrated_ground: Plant your weapon and hallow the ground around you for 5 seconds. Enemies on it burn with holy light, are slowed, take 20% more damage from every hit and are struck critically more often (+8% chance); you regenerate 2% of your life per second while you stand on it.
sk:holy_charge: Charge behind your shield toward the cursor and bash the first enemy in your path, stunning it. Where the charge ends, holy light burns the ground for 2 seconds, slowing enemies and healing you. The bash deals the full damage shown; the holy light deals 35% of it every half second. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.
sk:summon_holy_elemental: Call down a Holy Elemental of living light. It fights at your side, smashing your foes with blows of holy light that strike everything around them, until it is destroyed. A second elemental answers at gem level 10. Its light shelters you: within 9 metres of it you have +6% chance to block and regenerate 0.5% of your life a second. Shared Light: past 4 elementals, each deals 4% less per extra elemental standing (12: 32% less each). The army never shrinks, only the blow each one lands.
sk:pyre_of_faith: Light a pyre of holy fire around you: enemies inside burn twice a second for fire damage that grows with your maximum life. The pyre burns you too: 6% of your life per second, a quarter of that at 75% fire resistance, never the last tenth of your life: you need life regeneration. Press again to put it out. Its burn is a Fire spell hit: Fire, Spell, Area and Holy damage scale it; Burning damage modifiers scale Ignites, not the pyre.
sk:hallowed_slam: Bring your weapon down on the ground in front of you. Where it lands the ground is hallowed for 3 seconds, one new patch a second: enemies on it burn for 30% of the hit's damage twice a second and take 8% more damage from every hit, and you regain life while you stand in it.
sk:shield_throw: Hurl your shield at the enemy in front of you. It rings off the first enemy it strikes into the next, up to 3 more times, a little weaker at every leap. A Shield skill: while you hold a shield it gains 1% increased damage per 5 armour, evasion and energy shield on that shield, and Shield skill bonuses apply. Without a shield it keeps its full base damage.
sk:quick_shot: Loose an arrow at the target. Free to use.
sk:power_shot: Draw the bow to its full and loose a heavy arrow that pierces every enemy in its path.
sk:split_shot: Loose a fan of {Projectiles} arrows. Each enemy is struck by one arrow. One more arrow at gem levels 8 and 16.
sk:arrow_rain: Fire a volley into the sky. A moment later it rains down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times. Aimed at an enemy, the volley leads it: it falls where that enemy will be when the arrows land.
sk:wind_vault: Vault toward the cursor on a gust of wind (or back, away from it, when the cursor is close), shoving nearby enemies away on landing and loosing three arrows at the nearest. The damage shown is a full hit: each landing arrow deals 60% of it and the gust 15%. Cancels attacks. The arrows are not projectiles: Projectile skill bonuses do not change them.
sk:lightning_arrow: Loose an arrow charged with lightning. Half its physical damage is converted to lightning. When it strikes an enemy, lightning leaps from it to {Chains} more {Chains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies) for 72% of the hit, a tenth less on each jump. The first enemy takes the full damage shown. With no other enemy in reach, the leaps it cannot make come back into that enemy as one extra strike, so a lone boss takes about 29% more.
sk:summon_ballista: Plant a ballista where you aim (up to 9 metres away) that turns on the nearest enemy and looses heavy bolts for 10 seconds. One at a time: the Multiple Totems support and the passive tree add more, and every one you add counts. Supports on this gem change its bolts. Each bolt pierces one enemy; with Chain or Fork linked it chains or forks at its first enemy instead.
sk:caustic_arrow: Loose a rotten arrow that bursts into a caustic cloud where it strikes, one new cloud a second. The cloud lingers for 3 seconds and poisons every enemy inside for 30% of the hit's damage twice a second. 60% of its damage is poison.
sk:fuse_arrow: Loose an arrow with a burning fuse. It bursts in fire where it strikes, hitting every enemy around the target. 60% of its damage is fire.
sk:twin_cuts: Your blades' basic attack, no mana cost. A quick cut with each blade at the enemy in front of you.
sk:flurry: A storm of five quick cuts in front of you; the last one is a heavy finisher that throws enemies back. Your blades' mana skill; Twin Cuts is their free attack.
sk:iaido_thrust: Dash through enemies toward the cursor, cutting everything on your line. A moment later you sheathe and they bleed for a second cut. The dash cut deals the full damage shown, the sheathe cut 38% of it. Every enemy you cut stays marked for 5 seconds, and each new cut on a marked enemy adds 25% of that cut to its mark: Sheathe makes them burst. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.
sk:crescent_slash: A heavy cross cut with both blades. The cut flies on as a crescent wave that slices through every enemy on its line.
sk:shuriken_fan: Flick a fan of {Projectiles} spinning shuriken at the enemy. Each one cuts through {Pierce} {Pierce}|plural(one=foe,other=foes) before it stops. One more at gem levels 10 and 18.
sk:blade_vortex: {OrbitCount} spectral {OrbitCount}|plural(one=blade joins,other=blades join) a ring that circles you for 6 seconds, sweeping out into the pack and back, cutting every enemy they pass. Cast again to add more: up to {OrbitMax} blades. While it is on your bar, every basic attack that lands adds a blade.
sk:thousand_cuts: Become a blur of steel: fly from group to group around you five times, cutting everything near each one. The last cut is the heaviest. You end beside the last group you cut. Counts as a Movement skill and as a dash: movement supports, passives, items and Echo Cut apply (Echo Cut adds one more cut where you end). It is still a melee attack.
sk:sheathe: Sheathe your blades with a click. Every enemy your Iaido Thrust has marked bursts apart, nearest first, for 160% of its mark, and half of that to everything around it. A mark is the strongest Iaido cut on that enemy plus 25% of every other cut it took while marked, so thrust through it a few times before you sheathe. Needs marks: cut enemies with Iaido Thrust first.
sk:viper_fang: Three quick poisoned stabs at the enemy in front of you. Most of their damage is poison, and every stab lays a stack of poison that keeps eating at the enemy after you move on.
sk:moonfall: Leap to the cursor and fall on the enemies there with both blades. As you sheathe them a moment later, every enemy you struck is cut again for half the damage. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.
sk:cyclone: Hold to spin with your weapon outstretched, moving toward the cursor through enemies and cutting everything around you. Costs mana while you spin.
sk:shield_charge: Charge toward the cursor behind your shield, ploughing through every enemy in your way, and burst on arrival: the blast hits everything around you. Each enemy the blast catches gives back 1.5 mana. Almost no cooldown, chain it from pack to pack.
sk:earthshatter: Slam the ground so hard it splits: a fissure tears toward the cursor, hitting everything on its line. Enemies it kills leave a spike of rock that shatters a moment later, hitting those around it.
sk:rending_slam: Bring a two-handed weapon down so hard the ground rends: a shock runs out in a straight line toward the cursor, hitting every enemy on it. Your body is in the blow: 4% of your maximum life joins the weapon's base damage. No cooldown.
sk:wheeling_axe: Hurl a spinning axe toward the cursor. It cuts through every enemy in its path, then wheels back to your hand and cuts them again on the way.
sk:vow_of_clarity: Swear a Vow of clear thought: you regenerate mana. Reserves a small, flat amount of mana while sworn (it fits an early mana pool). Press again to break it (Vowbreak): for 4 seconds your skills cost no mana, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds and you are Forsworn.
sk:vow_of_vigor: Swear a Vow of the living body: you regenerate life, and your attacks gain a little mana on hit. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Vowbreak: heal a quarter of your life at once and regenerate far faster for 4 seconds.
sk:woe_of_withering: Lay a Woe on every enemy in an area: they take more Poison damage, more damage of every kind and move slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it: the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread (+3% Woe effect per Dread, up to 20). An enemy that dies under it spreads the Woe to 2 nearby enemies. Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
sk:toll_of_dread: Ring the toll: every Woe in an area is consumed and each cursed enemy takes Poison damage, 10% more per Dread it carried.
sk:death_sentence: Sentence one enemy: it takes 25% more damage from everything. Only one enemy can be Sentenced; sentencing another lifts the first. When it dies you gain an Insight charge. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian the Sentence holds until it dies and grows by itself, up to +30% (32.5% more damage taken).
sk:jarls_roar: A war cry of the old jarls: enemies around you turn on you, and you gain a Resolve charge for each enemy it reaches (up to 3). Resolve: 6% reduced physical damage taken and +6% to elemental resistances per charge.
sk:war_banner_skill: Plant your War Banner where you aim (up to 8 metres away); use it again to move it. Enemies within 6 metres of the banner take 6% more damage. Every enemy that dies near it adds a Valour (+0.5% more, up to 20); a Rare, Unique or Guardian fighting near it adds one every 2 seconds. Moving the banner keeps half its Valour. Walk away and it falls. An enemy under both your banner and your Hunter's Marks takes only the stronger of the two.
sk:woe_of_cinders: Lay a Woe of Cinders on every enemy in an area: its Fire resistance falls by 20. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
sk:woe_of_rime: Lay a Woe of Rime on every enemy in an area: its Cold resistance falls by 20 and it moves 10% slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
sk:woe_of_the_tempest: Lay a Woe of the Tempest on every enemy in an area: its Lightning resistance falls by 20. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
sk:woe_of_sundering: Lay a Woe of Sundering on every enemy in an area: it takes 20% more Physical damage. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
sk:woe_of_faltering: Lay a Woe of Faltering on every enemy in an area: its hits deal 20% less damage and it moves 20% slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
sk:herald_of_embers: Swear a Herald of fire: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra fire damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills burst into flame: 12% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as fire damage within 2.5 metres. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Fire and Elemental damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life. A skill linked to Brutality gains nothing from it (Brutality deals no elemental damage).
sk:herald_of_rime: Swear a Herald of cold: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra cold damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills shatter: 10% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as cold damage within 3 metres (it chills). Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Cold and Elemental damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life. A skill linked to Brutality gains nothing from it (Brutality deals no elemental damage).
sk:herald_of_storms: Swear a Herald of lightning: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra lightning damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills arc to the 3 nearest enemies within 5 metres: 8% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as lightning damage. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Lightning and Elemental damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life. A skill linked to Brutality gains nothing from it (Brutality deals no elemental damage).
sk:herald_of_rot: Swear a Herald of poison: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra poison damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills burst into rot: 10% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as poison damage within 2.5 metres. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Poison damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life.
sk:vow_of_the_bulwark: Swear a Vow against the elements and venom: +10% to fire, cold, lightning and poison resistances at gem level 1, +19.5% at 20 (never past your maximum). Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the resistances are 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.
sk:vow_of_iron: Swear a Vow of iron: 20% more Armour at gem level 1, 29.5% at 20. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the Armour bonus is 2.5 times as strong (about 74% more at 20) for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.
sk:vow_of_the_wind: Swear a Vow of the wind: 20% more Evasion at gem level 1, 29.5% at 20. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the Evasion bonus is 2.5 times as strong (about 74% more at 20) for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.
sk:vow_of_warding: Swear a Vow of warding: 20% more Energy Shield and 20% faster Energy Shield recharge at gem level 1, 29.5% more and 39% faster at 20. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): both bonuses are 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.
